title: LLM Post-Training as Brownfield Maintenance: An Industrial Perspective on Dataware Engineering
abstract: arXiv:2608.31102v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Industrial post-training is a brownfield regime. Teams inherit a deployed checkpoint and must land targeted improvements under fixed compute and mixture budgets without regressing the rest. The maintained artifact is increasingly dataware: behavior governed by a curated post-training mixture, updated via bounded mixture patches rather than clean-slate retraining. From an industrial code-generation improvement effort, we offer a maintainer's perspective on why this work is hard in practice, distilling three recurring challenges, zero-sum mixture design, yield as the binding metric, and end-to-end integration under uncertainty, and arguing that progress depends less on one-off recipes than on an engineering discipline for programming dataware. translated_title: 将大语言模型后训练视为棕地维护：数据件工程的工业视角
translated_abstract: 工业界的后训练是一种“棕地”（存量系统）维护体制。团队继承一个已部署的模型检查点，必须在固定的算力与数据配比预算下落地有针对性的改进，同时不能使其余能力发生退化。所维护的工件越来越成为“数据件”：其行为由精心策划的后训练数据配比所支配，通过有边界的配比补丁进行更新，而非从零开始的重新训练。基于一次工业级代码生成能力改进工作，我们从维护者的视角阐述这项工作在实践中为何困难，提炼出三个反复出现的挑战——零和的配比设计、以“产出率”作为约束性指标，以及不确定性下的端到端集成——并论证进展更多依赖于对数据件进行编程的工程学科，而非一次性的配方。在我们的案例研究中，那些提升教师蒸馏转化为可用训练数据比例的干预措施，在使用相同的解题教师模型与……的情况下，使被采纳的监督数据量提升了2.84倍。
tldr: 该论文提出将工业界大语言模型后训练视为对“数据件”的棕地维护，提炼出零和配比设计、产出率作为约束性指标、不确定性下端到端集成三大挑战，并通过案例证明提升蒸馏数据转化率可使有效监督数据增加2.84倍。
en_tdlr: This paper reframes industrial LLM post-training as brownfield maintenance of "dataware," distills three recurring challenges (zero-sum mixture design, yield as the binding metric, and end-to-end integration under uncertainty), and shows in a case study that interventions improving distillation-to-usable-data conversion increased accepted supervision by 2.84 times.
